claim: The piezo controller's interface library can emulate a controller when none is fitted, addressed as sim:/NPC followed by the controller part number (optionally with a firmware version), and every command sent to the emulator returns zero. It is for testing that an application runs, not for testing what a controller would answer.
validity_conditions: Vendor specification, read from the manual itself (10.3 rule 2); E3 vendor_spec. Slot: O1 preflight and the device wrapper -- a session that finds every read returning zero may be talking to the emulator and not a controller, so a zero read-back is not evidence that a stage is at zero. For the library release the manual documents, 2.7.9; a later release may differ. Whether the emulator opens a serial port is not in the manual and is listed as unmeasured by the microscope seat. Falsified by an emulator command returning non-zero. Delivered as item `prior_simulator_no_controller` of microscope_agent/findings/microscope-20260924-2-20260924.json at a0fda99 (card 043); the source was opened and its sha256 recorded before this was ruled.
